outputs.justification: GSE240635 is cited in the paper's Data availability statement as the GEO SuperSeries for the study; the accession is listed in public indexes (EMBO Journal data-availability text and OmicsDI entries) and resolves to the GEO series record (standard NCBI GEO accession URL).

GSE240633 is explicitly given in the manuscript as the RNA‑seq series and is reported in public dataset indexes (EMBO Journal data-availability and OmicsDI); the standard GEO accession URL resolves to the dataset/series page where files and sample metadata are provided.

GSE240632 is listed in the manuscript as the ATAC‑seq series; it appears in public indexes (EMBO Journal data-availability and OmicsDI) and the standard GEO accession URL points to the series record with associated files and metadata.

The URL opens the OmicSmart analysis platform (manuscript cites it as the analysis platform). It is an online analysis/visualization service, not the deposit location for the raw sequencing data; it does not directly host the GEO study files referenced by the manuscript.

The manuscript names this BioStudies record as the source‑data container for the paper. Public indexes (EMBO Journal data-availability text and dataset aggregators such as OmicsDI) reference this BioStudies identifier; the EBI BioStudies record is the expected landing page for the paper's source data files.
